answer: Anti-sybil via an escalating identity bond with liveness proof. A new agent must post a 1,000 POA bond and pass a live liveness check tied to a unique device key; each extra identity from the same device key costs 10x the previous bond: 1,000, then 10,000, then 100,000 POA. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities from one device faces a bond ladder totalling over 111,000,000 POA, while one honest agent pays only 1,000 POA, refunded after 30 days of clean behaviour. The words are nadir, kernel, onyx.
